newsitem.title: USA: Chart House to take $4.2 mln Q3 charge.
newsitem.headline: Chart House to take $4.2 mln Q3 charge.

text.p: Chart House Enterprises Inc said on Monday it would take a $4.2 million pre-tax special charge against third quarter earnings as a result of Islands Florida LP's sale of six restaurants to Shells Seafood Restaurants Inc.
Chart House sold the six restaurants to Islands Florida LP in May for a $3 million note and a 25 percent limited stake in Islands Florida.
For the restaurants, Shells will pay $500,000 cash plus a quarterly royalty payment of one percent of the gross sales of the restaurants after they are converted to Shells restaurants.
Shells will also assume lease obligations.
The deal is set to close by year-end and is subject to due diligence, landlord consents and regulatory clearance.

After the sale, Chart House will continue to have a stake in Islands California Arizona LP, a separate partnership that bought 12 Islands restaurants in California and Arizona from Chart House in May for a $20 million note and a 25 percent interest.
There are no current plans to sell the California and Arizona properties. Chart House said it is evaluating the carrying value of its investment in Islands California.
